In transformer LLM inference, the KV cache stores the key and value pairs from the attention mechanism for each token. This avoids recomputing these values for earlier tokens in subsequent steps, thus speeding up the inference process. By reusing these cached values, the model can focus on processing new information more efficiently.<tool_call>
